name: io.github.CritterCodes/stuller-mcp
description: MCP server for the Stuller jewelry-supply v2 API: product search, real-time pricing & availability, product detail/media, and gated ordering.

environmentVariables.name: STULLER_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Stuller developer-login username (a developer login authorizes API calls only; it is not your stuller.com website login).

environmentVariables.name: STULLER_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.stuller.com.

environmentVariables.name: STULLER_DISABLE_ORDERING
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'true' to hard-disable the submit_order write tool regardless of the confirm flag.
